answer: Each bonded identity locks collateral in escrow, so splitting stake does not erase liability: when k identities coordinate equivocation, pairwise evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k^2). Detection also applies asymmetric, compounding depreciation to remaining bonded capital, giving a sybil swarm an exponential multiplier in total capital loss as coordinated identities grow. The timber ledger records claims, while a basalt checkpoint acts as an anchor for proofs and slashing settlement.
